attchmntText: INTEGRATED FILING (FINANCIAL) INCLUDING UN-AUDITED REVIEWED FINANCIAL RESULTS ALONG WITH LIMITED REVIEW REPORT FOR THE QUARTER & HALF YEAR ENDED ON 30TH SEPTEMBER, 2026 & RELEVANT ANNEXURES.
voiceSummary: Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Limited filed its integrated financial filing for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The unaudited reviewed financial results were approved by the Board of Directors during a meeting held on 13th November 2026 in New Delhi. The meeting commenced at 04:55 PM and concluded at 05:10 PM. The results were physically signed by Shri Rajiv Kumar, Director Finance, with DIN 09811051, and Shri Sudhakararao Papa, Director Technical, with DIN 10801670. Both directors were authorized by the Board for this purpose. The Chairman and Managing Director participated via video conferencing. The financial statements were prepared as per Ind AS and include a limited review report from the statutory auditors. The results are published in newspapers and available on the company website. Regulation 54 of SEBI LODR Regulations does not apply as MTNL bonds are unsecured.

attchmntText: COMPLIANCE WITH REGULATION 30 & 51 OF SEBI (LODR) REGULATIONS, 2015 & SEBI CIRCULAR NO SEBI/HO/CFD/CMD1/CIR/P/2019/140 DATED 21.11.2019   INTIMATION OF DEFAULT IN THE PAYMENT OF PRINCIPAL (INSTALMENT) & INTEREST OF BANKS BY MTNL AS ON 31.10.2026
voiceSummary: Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Limited intimates default in payment of principal and interest to banks as on 31st October 2026. The company has defaulted with Union Bank of India, Bank of India, Punjab National Bank, State Bank of India, UCO Bank, Punjab and Sind Bank, and Indian Overseas Bank. The total outstanding bank borrowings amount to Rs 9,812 crore. The total financial indebtedness, including short term and long term debt, stands at Rs 37,633 crore. This comprises the bank loan of Rs 9,812 crore, SG Bond of Rs 24,071 crore, and loan from DoT for paying SG Bond interest of Rs 3,750 crore. The disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 and 51 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015.

attchmntText: COMPLIANCE OF REGULATION 30 & 51 OF SEBI (LODR) REGULATIONS, 2015 - DISCLOSURE OF EVENTS OR INFORMATION   DISCLOSURE OF IMPOSITION OF FINES OR PENALTIES BY TRAI
voiceSummary: Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Limited received an order from the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India dated 10.11.2026 imposing a financial disincentive of Rs. 6,00,000. This penalty is for contravention of Regulation 9 and Regulation 10 of the Standards of Quality of Service of Access and Broadband Service Regulations, 2024. The violation pertains to Broadband Wireline Service for the quarter ending June 2026. MTNL disclosed this event in compliance with SEBI LODR Regulations. The company stated that the total penalty of Rs. 6,00,000 has no material impact on its financial, operational, or other activities.
